verdict.rationale: Isaac is a robotics simulation and learning platform. Its docs mention standalone scripts, headless operation, Docker, and that developers can 'automate workflows', but these are building blocks for writing your own pipelines. There is no documented product feature for setting up automations, triggers or schedules that run autonomously in the background, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
